purpose: Implement durable host-neutral workspace identity so project path/name/location observations never become identity and move/recovery can be distinguished explicitly from duplicate/fork without cross-Song context leakage.

lineage.outcome: Moving, renaming, Save-As, duplicating, forking or recovering a DAW project cannot silently attach the wrong Song/context or manufacture a new workspace identity from a filesystem path.
lineage.capability: Stable workspace identity and explicit move/duplicate/fork/recovery reconciliation

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 Song/profile identity and durable SQLite
legacy_rejections: Ableton Set as universal workspace owner
host process name as project identity

completion_proof: move/rename and recovery append observations while preserving the same opaque workspace ID
duplicate and fork create distinct workspace IDs with explicit source-workspace lineage
a location currently claimed by another workspace cannot silently merge identities
an old location becomes reusable after the original workspace has explicitly moved elsewhere without resurrecting the old identity
ambiguous SAVE_AS/unknown relation is rejected until caller chooses SAME_OR_MOVED, RECOVERED, DUPLICATE or FORK
an existing workspace cannot silently change host family; cross-host continuation must be an explicit fork/new workspace
runtime version changes remain observations and do not regenerate workspace identity
workspace identity and observation history are immutable/append-only and survive restart
runtime identity evidence is reproducibly fingerprint-validated on reopen and tampering fails visibly
current-location lookup returns observational candidates only; no get-by-path identity API exists
repeated reads write zero rows and workspace events enter canonical Activity chronology
next_selection_rule: After DAW-00B evidence, reconcile and globally compare FocusContext, Host Shadow/reconciliation, feature/environment evidence and Musical IR/portability against preserved PLATFORM-00 and CORE-02. Do not select a named DAW adapter by historical maturity.
